overall_reason: The system UI stack (Segoe UI drew every glyph at 1440 per fonts.json; system-ui computed at 375) sets every role, which fits a product-UI (Operate) composition on a clear 14/12/11px ladder, but in all three controls the text sits above the optical centre of its icon.

score.reason: T-LEADING: the sizes are fine, but the search placeholder, 'Export files' and 'Preview' each ride about 2px high against their icons and boxes.

findings.title: Give menus/controls with descenders enough leading to avoid clipping
findings.where: Search field, 'Export files' button and 'Preview' link, 1440
findings.evidence: On P40/01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png (zoomed), 'Search files' sits above the magnifier's centre, 'Export files' sits above the download icon's centre, and 'Preview' sits above its arrow. In dom-1440.json the labels are 11 to 12px text in an 18px line box (1.5 to 1.64), which puts the x-height above the box centre.
findings.before: Labels at 11 to 12px in an 18px line box, centred by the box and not by the glyphs
findings.after: Centre each label on its x-height against the icon: use a line-height near 1.2 to 1.35 inside the control and align the items to centre, or nudge the icon
findings.why: Text that rides high next to an icon looks misaligned at a glance, even though the box metrics are centred.

strengths: A clear head (14/550) over 12px input text and an 11px button label.
Button and link labels do not wrap.
